انجبروا (form VII)
# اِنْجَبَرُوا (injabarū) /in.d͡ʒa.ba.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْجَبَرَ (injabara)
# اِنْجَبِرُوا (injabirū) /in.d͡ʒa.bi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْجَبَرَ (injabara)
